historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally preserves a non-mutating connectivity check but underestimates root management-plane exposure.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds BMC-shell versus pass-through path identity, authorization, host-key verification, secure credential broker, redaction, session audit and revocation/restoration.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved support/debug route can establish an authorized SMC SSH session and return valid non-mutating help/status evidence for the correct UBB without exposing credentials or leaving debug access enabled unexpectedly.
original_method: Validate management target, route and host fingerprint, connect with a brokered temporary credential, run only approved help/status commands, capture redacted identity/audit evidence, close the session and revoke/restore access state.
manual_activity: Security/engineering authorizes the privileged route and credential lifecycle; operator provides OOB oversight if needed; engineer decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Approved SMC management address and BMC-shell or pass-through route
Expected SMC firmware/UBB identity and host fingerprint
Temporary authorized key/credential broker and account role
Audit, redaction, revocation/debug-disable and protected evidence policy
safety_requirements: Never use or reproduce the Master plaintext root password
Verify host identity independently before authentication
Limit the session to approved non-mutating commands
Stop on route/host/auth/prompt/role anomaly or sensitive output
Close/audit session and revoke credential/restore debug state
agent_execution_scope: Connect using the brokered temporary credential
Run only help and approved status/inventory and redact output
Do not bypass verification, store secrets, run write/power/firmware commands or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve route, account/credential and debug-production access policy
Approve command allowlist and evidence redaction/revocation
Resolve authentication/identity/audit issues and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Help/status is suitable read-only evidence, but an address alone is insufficient; privileged route, host identity and secure credential lifecycle are mandatory.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Connect through the approved route with verified fingerprint and temporary credentials, run the allowlisted `help` and status command, then close/revoke and preserve redacted audit evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC-shell/pass-through alternatives, SMC SSH accessibility and source 5/5 timing are retained without using the exposed credential.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a short-lived audited access transaction binding UBB/SMC identity, route, fingerprint, role, allowed commands, redacted results and revocation confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes default-secret exposure and adds trust/audit/cleanup without reducing access verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Network reachability alone is insufficient; successful authorized session and correct endpoint evidence remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Debug SSH may be intentionally unavailable in production; environment policy must explicitly define expected state.

project_override_considerations: Project/security authority may choose BMC-shell or pass-through and may require debug disabled in production, but must define how pre-production support-access coverage is evidenced without default credentials.
expected_evidence: Verified host fingerprint and temporary account role without secrets
Connection status, prompt/banner and approved help/status outputs
SMC firmware/identity match and command/session timestamps
Session closure, credential revocation/debug restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure presents two legitimate access routes to the same SMC SSH function; the plaintext default credential is a security defect, not competing test intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Authorized route and temporary access can be supplied; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Converts a default-root login example into a verified, least-privilege, audited and self-cleaning SMC support-access test.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful TCP connection does not prove the target is the intended SMC, and accepting an unknown host key can redirect privileged credentials. Root/debug access also persists beyond a read-only command unless the credential and enablement state are closed out. Endpoint identity, authorized role, command allowlist and revocation are therefore part of the test evidence, not optional hygiene.
